context_local_repair.interpretation: Context sometimes induces a local repair, but collateral target/vote regressions frequently erase global feasibility.

bottleneck_decision.routing_selector: NOT_PRIMARY_AT_EVENT_LEVEL: every orphan had another eligible member and every orphan eventually had such a member selected.
bottleneck_decision.context_construction: MATERIAL: only 24/42 branch-revisited orphans reached explicit conditioned context.
bottleneck_decision.generation_candidate_quality: PRIMARY: 173/214 rejected candidates had no positive joint target/vote geometry.
bottleneck_decision.coalition_geometry: SECONDARY_BUT_REAL: 30/214 rejected candidates were target-positive but vote-negative.
bottleneck_decision.acceptance_objective: NOT_PRIMARY: only 11/214 rejected candidates were target-negative but vote-positive.
bottleneck_decision.selection_ranking: NOT_OBSERVED_AS_POST_FEASIBILITY_BOTTLENECK: all 33 feasible candidates were A/B; 25 committed and 8 lost max-one competition.

recommended_next_action: Do not implement v16 yet. Use a fixed-pool offline design comparison that jointly increases explicit orphan context inclusion and reduces global collateral damage; preserve common-safe acceptance until evidence stronger than the 11 E-type candidates supports changing it.
